swift_provider.schema_layout_note: Canonical schemas reside under knowledge/ssiag/schemas/v1; v1 denotes schema/protocol generation, not provider package release. The bare executable receipt owns its binary; complete bundle receipts own admitted bundle files. Do not invent installed schema copies.
swift_provider.implemented_support: Source SwiftPM build/test and explicit receipt-v2 installation/uninstallation; metadata handshake and signed-bundle/session readiness only.
swift_provider.production_delivery_boundary: Bare SwiftPM executable is a metadata-only development/compatibility artifact. scripts/build-production-bundle.sh requires explicitly approved bundle identity/native policy/entitlements/signing; signed/notarized artifact qualification is not established by this inventory.
swift_provider.execution_note: Bounded local SSIAG-controlled native subprocess; no Linux implementation, no always-running daemon, no live Keychain secret access.
